_readme: Hand-anchored figure boxes, applied by scripts/figures/backfill.ts AFTER derive.py and winning over it. Fractional [x0,y0,x1,y1], page 0-based. Use for (a) a figure the derivation refuses because no clean rectangle exists on that layout, and (b) a derived box that is right but catches a stray line. Every entry carries a `why` — a coordinate with no reason behind it cannot be re-checked.

10.5.why: derived top edge sat at 0.2897 and caught the line '(iii) Coinitial' (measured y 0.2897-0.3067). Three set-member rows share this figure, so for (i) Collinear and (ii) Equal that line is the WRONG sub-question's label printed above their diagram. Top moved just below it; nothing else changed.
